Editor.Title: Token Maker
Editor.StageLabel: Portrait: drag to move, scroll to zoom, arrow keys to nudge
Editor.HowTo: Drag to move · scroll to zoom (Shift: finer) · double-click to reset
Editor.FitHint: Show the whole portrait inside the token
Editor.ResetHint: Back to the starting crop (face near the top)
Editor.AccentAutoHint: Green for friendly, yellow for neutral, red for hostile, purple for secret
Editor.Tainted: This image is on another website, so the browser won't let it be saved. Choose a copy from the server or from your computer.
Editor.LoadFailed: The image could not be loaded. Choose another one.

framed.Name: Framed
framed.Hint: Our frame is drawn into the image; Foundry's ring is switched off

ring.Name: Foundry ring
ring.Hint: A round cut of the portrait with Foundry's dynamic token ring around it

ring.Name: Ring
ring.Hint: A plain ring in the colour you pick

gilded.Name: Gilded
gilded.Hint: Gold with four gems in the colour you pick

silver.Name: Silver
silver.Hint: Polished silver with a coloured inner line

arcane.Name: Arcane
arcane.Hint: A dark band of glowing runes

blades.Name: Blades
blades.Hint: Iron with a crown of blades pointing inward

glitch.Name: Glitch
glitch.Hint: A broken, flickering ring of colour

Sheet.Button: Make a token from this portrait

Notify.NoGM: A GM must be online to save the token (players can't upload files).
Notify.TooBig: The image is too large to send. Pick a smaller image size.
Notify.Timeout: The GM's client did not answer in time.
Notify.UploadFailed: The image could not be saved.
Notify.PlayersOff: Players may not make tokens in this world.
Notify.Done: New token for {name} ({tokens} on this scene updated): {path}

players.Name: Players can make tokens
players.Hint: Owners of a character can use the Token Maker on its sheet. Players without upload permission send the image to the GM's client, which saves it.

folder.Name: Folder for new tokens
folder.Hint: Where images are saved in your user data. Empty: worlds/<this world>/planar-tokens

sheetButton.Name: Button on the portrait
sheetButton.Hint: Show a small button over the portrait on character and NPC sheets (the entry in the sheet's menu is always there).

defaultSize.Name: Default image size
defaultSize.Hint: Size of new token images in pixels, until a user picks another.
